entities.summary: Jesse David Edwards is a Dutch professional basketball player for Baskonia of the Liga ACB and the EuroLeague. He played college basketball for the Syracuse Orange and the West Virginia Mountaineers. Standing at 2.13 m, he plays the center position. He also plays for the Netherlands men's national basketball team.
